prompt: Write a recorded statement transcript (about 250 words) between an insurance adjuster (lines start with 'Q:') and the claimant (lines start with 'A:'). The claimant was the driver in a side impact at intersection in Katy, Texas, and has knee injury. No names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1051; do not mention it.)
text:
Q: Thank you for taking the time to give this recorded statement. Please state your full name for the record.

A: I'd rather not give my full name on a recording, but you can use the claim number.

Q: That's fine. Can you tell me where you were when the collision occurred?

A: I was driving through the intersection in Katy, heading east on the main road. The light had been green when I approached.

Q: Did you see the other vehicle before the impact?

A: Not really. I saw a car coming from the left side just as I got into the middle of the intersection. I tried to brake, but there wasn't time.

Q: Which part of your vehicle was struck?

A: The driver's side door took most of the hit. The airbags deployed, and my car was pushed sideways into the curb on the right.

Q: Were you wearing your seatbelt?

A: Yes, I was.

Q: Can you describe your injuries?

A: My left knee hit the dashboard and the door frame. It swelled up right away and I can't bend it fully. I went to urgent care that same afternoon and they told me to follow up with an orthopedic doctor.

Q: Have you been able to see that doctor yet?

A: I have an appointment scheduled, but I'm still limping and having trouble with stairs. I've been using a brace.

Q: Did anyone else in the vehicle get hurt?

A: No, I was alone in the car.

Q: Is there anything else you'd like to add to your statement?

A: Only that I've been careful to keep all my receipts and medical paperwork, and I can send them over whenever you need them.

Q: Thank you. This concludes the recorded statement.
